summary: Reviewed namnx-vn/crm-demo against learning-plan/README.md and Day 7. Conclusion: curriculum concepts/demos are largely covered through Zustand and TanStack Query mutation/optimistic demos, but the project is not yet plan-complete because the main /customers flow lacks integrated search, pagination, URL searchParams, parameterized query keys, empty state, route loading/error boundaries, and the main /customers/[id] page lacks an integrated edit form/mutation/cache refresh. Current master has basic customer list/detail links, component loading/error states, and integrated Zustand selection. Recommended next step: implement Day 7 end-to-end on the primary customer routes, then run final Definition-of-Done review.
